title: Al-Ma'un 107:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 45 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ma'un 107:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 45. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ (١) فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ (٢) وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ (٣)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

keywords.def: an orphan: a child whose father has died

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ma'un 107:1-3 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 107:1-3 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Think of one way your family can help a poor person this week.
questions.a: For example: give food to a food bank.

options: pushes away the orphan and does not urge feeding the poor
questions.a: A) pushes away the orphan and does not urge feeding the poor. 107:2 to 3.

questions.q: Think again: Imagine a child with no mother or father. How should we treat them?
questions.a: Kindly and gently; Al-Ma'un warns about the person who pushes the orphan away.
